menu.speaker: narrator
menu.text: CREW NOTICEBOARD. {'Seven' if day() < 3 else 'Nine'} unread notices.

choices.text: 'Night movement in the hangar' - Sgt. Halloran
'To whoever keeps taking the stims' - Dr. Pell

wren.speaker: narrator
wren.text: 'Third month running my seed crate arrives one short. The manifest says it is all there. The manifest and I are going to have words. - Wren'

hal.speaker: narrator
hal.text: 'Motion logs show somebody in the Hangar Bay between 01:00 and 04:00 on several nights. If that is you: there is nothing down there worth losing sleep over. If it is not you: tell me. - Halloran'

dex.speaker: narrator
dex.text: 'All requisitions must carry the Administrator's countersignature. No, I do not make the rules. Yes, I am available for private purchases at any time. - Dex'

pell.speaker: narrator
pell.text: 'I am not angry. I am worried. My door is open and nothing you tell me goes in the log. - J.P.'

pip.speaker: narrator
pip.text: 'RADIO CLUB meets whenever the array works!! (Has not met yet.) If anyone knows how to get the amplifier core out of the security locker, I will do your laundry for a year. - Pip'
